next_tickets.title: S36c: conformal timing intervals for overlapping-pulse deconvolution
next_tickets.body: Question: Can run-held-out conformal calibration fix the S36b TCN uncertainty under-coverage while preserving overlap AP and timing sigma68? Compare split-conformal and run-block conformalized intervals on the S36b synthetic-injection and real high-rate strata, report 68/95 coverage, interval width, AP, timing RMSE, energy bias, and PID proxy confusion with bootstrap CIs. Expected information gain: separates architecture error from uncertainty-calibration error for deployable overlapping-pulse deconvolution.

novel_tickets_appended: 1784065616.1187.1fd56f45: S36c: conformal timing intervals for overlapping-pulse deconvolution
caveats: Truth comes from controlled injections into raw-ROOT-derived clean pulses.
Saturation is represented by an amplitude-ceiling proxy rather than electronics saturation flags.
PID confusion is a stave-conditioned energy-bias proxy, not particle truth.
